answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, unlocked only after continuous uptime. The hollow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The comet holds work receipts rather than names, so the willow of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
